articles.summary: Kratos has been awarded a $20 million+ contract to deliver mobile satellite communication (SATCOM) gateways for a defense customer in Asia.
articles.title: Kratos Wins $20 Million Contract to Deliver Mobile SATCOM Gateways for Resilient Defense Network

articles.summary: Kratos announced the successful mission of its Aegis Readiness Assessment Vehicle Type B (ARAV-B) ballistic missile target from the Pacific Missile Range Facility in Hawaii.
articles.title: Kratos ARAV-B Ballistic Missile Target Successfully Utilized In Multinational Pacific Dragon 2026 Exercise
